series.description: Data series to plot. Each entry renders one line.

xKey.description:
Determines X-axis labels.
- **string**: property name for direct value lookup
- **function**: custom extraction and formatting in one step

data.description: Array of data objects. Each object represents one data point.

units.description:
Unit suffix appended to Y-axis labels and tooltip values.
Examples: "ms", "%", " records"
